purpose: Whether the constitutive guarantees change the structural outcome of the unchanged coupon when the 100 kN resultant is applied in fewer, larger increments.
newton: Full Newton with the consistent tangent, no line search and no step cutting; converged when the free residual norm is below 1e-5 N or its ratio to the first residual of the increment is below 1e-7; at most 50 iterations per increment; a failure ends the run.
outcomes: per-iterate residual, Gauss points outside the training box, minimum det C
final displacement error against the nested FOM at 100 kN, whose final state is path-independent
reporting: Every run is reported whatever its outcome; nothing is rerun, tuned or replaced after execution.
